H8NJ03073.name: Frank Pallone
H8NJ03073.bio: U.S. Representative for New Jersey's 6th District and Ranking Member of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

positions.stance: Believes the economy can grow by raising wages, strengthening workplace protections, and investing in national infrastructure.
Supports adequate resources and pay for local schools and teachers, and is committed to increasing Pell Grants and keeping student loan rates low.
Supports incentivizing clean, renewable energy such as solar and offshore wind, and keeping the U.S. in the Paris Agreement.
Believes all Americans should have access to high-quality, affordable health care, and defends the Affordable Care Act.
Supports adequate funding for veterans programs to improve health services, job opportunities and education for veterans.

H0NJ07261.name: Thomas Kean Jr.
H0NJ07261.bio: U.S. Representative for New Jersey's 7th District.

positions.stance: Focused on pro-growth policies that support small businesses, remove regulatory barriers to job creation, and restore supply chains.
Says schools serve children best when the federal footprint is reduced, local control is restored, and parents are empowered.
Supports an "all-the-above" energy policy to boost domestic production for an affordable, reliable, diverse energy supply.
Wants affordable, patient-centered care with more access and transparency, letting families make their own medical decisions.
Committed to giving veterans the highest quality medical care and efficient delivery of their benefits.

H2AZ01354.name: Eli Crane
H2AZ01354.bio: Former Navy SEAL and small business owner serving as U.S. Representative for Arizona's 2nd District.

positions.stance: Supports secure borders and backed funding for border wall completion, more agents, and upgraded surveillance technology.
Has introduced bills to expand veterans' employment pathways and encourage the VA to consider more faith-based programs.
Favors low taxes and limited regulation, opposes taxpayer subsidies that pick winners and losers, and pushes single-subject spending bills.
Believes Tribal nations should have authority over the management of their lands.
Supports banning congressional stock trading and says he does not trade stocks himself.

H6MD03508.name: Austin Dyches
H6MD03508.bio: U.S. Army veteran and cybersecurity professional.

positions.stance: Runs a grassroots campaign taking no corporate PAC, defense contractor or AIPAC money.
Supports Medicare for All, universal housing guarantees, and a $25 federal minimum wage indexed to inflation.
Would vote to end all U.S. military aid to Israel and oppose authorizations for "endless war."
Supports abolishing ICE and replacing it with community-based immigration processing.
Supports taxing extreme wealth to rebuild infrastructure and invest in the federal workforce.

H8MD01094.name: Andy Harris
H8MD01094.bio: U.S. Representative for Maryland's 1st District and a military veteran.

positions.stance: Says the VA must be held accountable and reformed to improve wait times and quality of care for veterans.
Wants farmers protected from harmful federal regulations and says the estate tax must be eliminated.
Says strengthening the military and intelligence communities is key to keeping Americans safe.
Supports lowering the corporate tax rate and simplifying the tax code to keep jobs from moving overseas.
Believes local governments, not federal micromanagement, should set curricula, and supports quality education in public, private or home schools.
Supports fully funding the equipment service members need and ensuring veterans get good health care when they return home.
Supports health care freedom and choice, saying "the government should not be sitting in the exam room with you and your doctor."
Says Americans' inalienable rights must not be stripped away by Washington lobbyists.
Says families are the foundation of the country and government should respect, not interfere with, their values.
Says agriculture is the district's top economic driver and pledges to fight for the families who run farms.
Says the U.S. faces a severe border crisis and backs efforts to close the southern border and stop fentanyl trafficking.
Blames record inflation mainly on trillions of dollars in wasteful federal spending.
Works to promote American energy independence and reduce federal overreach in rural Colorado.
Pledges to ensure veterans and their families receive the benefits they earned.
Supports private property and water rights and opposes the federal 30x30 land conservation program.

H0MN04049.name: Betty McCollum
H0MN04049.bio: Former teacher serving as U.S. Representative for Minnesota's 4th District.

positions.stance: Strongly opposes weakening protections for endangered species or laws requiring humane treatment of animals.
Supports smart, strategic defense investments so U.S. service members are the best trained and equipped force in the world.
Supports robust federal funding for public schools and accessible, affordable higher education.
Supports action on climate change and introduced a bill to permanently protect the Boundary Waters wilderness.
Says comprehensive, affordable, quality health care is a fundamental right and calls the Affordable Care Act a major step forward.

H4LA01162.name: Randall Arrington
H4LA01162.bio: Retired naval aviator, federal law enforcement officer, and political science professor.

positions.stance: Pledges to be "a humble public servant, not a rock star celebrity" and pursue equal opportunity for all Americans.
Supports term limits for Congress: two terms in the Senate and four in the House.
Says tax dollars should solve problems at home, not be sent to foreign nations or fund their wars.

wiki:renada-collins.name: Renada Collins
wiki:renada-collins.bio: Entrepreneur and founder of Big Mouth Media Group.

positions.stance: Puts "People Over Profit," advocating a livable wage that reflects the true cost of living.
Wants federal funding directed to local infrastructure such as water mains and fire hydrants.
Believes housing is a fundamental right and wants it affordable at 80% of area median income, plus voucher literacy help.
Pledges to work for financial, trade and labor support for Louisiana's farmers and producers.
Says fossil fuels are the lifeblood of modern society and Louisiana's industry is a major contributor to the economy.
Committed to expanding access to affordable, patient-centered coverage and says overregulation has hurt the health care system.
Pledges to keep Southwest Louisiana's hurricane recovery a priority and demand a stronger response from FEMA.
Says every foreign visitor must be held accountable to U.S. laws and the borders must be protected.
Says Congress must control spending, balance the budget, and reform entitlement programs to resolve the debt crisis.
Believes competition should be encouraged and government intervention and regulation should be limited.
Says a just government protects life and honors marriage and family, with public assistance reserved for those truly in need.
Says government's purpose is to secure God-given rights such as life, liberty, free speech and religious exercise.
Believes government is more efficient and less corrupt when limited, and supports eliminating unnecessary regulations.

H6LA05184.name: Stewart Cathey Jr.
H6LA05184.bio: Louisiana State Senator, U.S. Army combat veteran, and small businessman from Monroe.

positions.stance: Running to fight for "safer communities, more opportunity, and a country where hard work still means something."
Pledges to keep fighting so veterans receive "the care, benefits, education, and opportunities they've earned."
Says he is running to protect freedoms, make life more affordable, and create more opportunity for Louisiana families.
Will focus on lowering energy costs, reining in reckless spending, and creating good-paying jobs.

source.label: press releases on their campaign site

H6LA05283.name: Austin Magee
H6LA05283.bio: Blue-collar small business owner and builder.

positions.stance: Wants to ban congressional stock trading, pass term limits, limit lobbying, and require financial transparency for politicians.
Supports common-sense fiscal responsibility so politicians do not "bankrupt our country."
Wants controls on AI to curb misinformation and says AI must never decide life or death.
